title: Rewrite meeting_details_screen.dart to new design system
instructions:
Rewrite lib/ui/meetings/meetingDetails/widgets/meeting_details_screen.dart using the new design system primitives. Pattern: DETAIL with presences list + actions.

**Cubit (DO NOT MODIFY):** MeetingDetailsCubit(meetingsRepository, meetingPresencesRepository, authRepository, carnivalBlocksRepository, meetingId) is already wired in lib/routing/router.dart. Constructor signature MUST stay identical.

**States (sealed-class pattern, match with switch/is):** MeetingDetailsInitial, MeetingDetailsLoading, MeetingDetailsLoaded(meeting, canDeleteMeeting, presencesStatus, markingPresenceStatus, deleteStatus), MeetingDetailsError(message).

**Inner states on loaded:** PresencesStatus (initial/loading/success/failure), MarkingPresenceStatus (initial/loading/success/failure), DeleteStatus (initial/loading/success/failure). Use nested switch or if-statements per the existing pattern.

**Widgets to use:** AppAppBar (with delete icon in actions when canDeleteMeeting), AppLoading, AppError, AppEmpty, AppCard (for sections), AppSectionHeader, AppListTile, AppButton, MemberCard, PresenceChip, AppFAB (for 'Marcar presença').

**Layout guidance:**
1. AppAppBar with title = meeting.title; show IconButton (Icons.delete_outline_rounded) in actions when state.canDeleteMeeting - on tap call AppDialog.confirm(isDestructive: true) then cubit.deleteMeeting().
2. Meeting header section (AppCard) - title (AppTypography.headlineSmall), date/time/location rendered via AppListTile rows (icon leading, label trailing).
3. Presences section (AppCard + AppSectionHeader 'Presenças (N)') - render each presence as a row with MemberCard on left and PresenceChip (PresenceChip.present/absent/pending) on right. Use BlocBuilder for inner presencesStatus. Empty -> AppEmpty inside card.
4. FAB (AppFAB) - 'Marcar presença' toggles the current user's presence status; call cubit.markPresence(). On loading state, disable interaction.

**Delete action flow:** AppDialog.confirm(isDestructive: true) -> cubit.deleteMeeting() -> on success context.pop() + AppSnackbar.info('Reunião removida').

**Preserve exactly:** constructor signature, sealed-class state matching, all entity field accesses, all pt-BR strings (do NOT translate).
validation: All string literals use double quotes
Cubit constructor signature unchanged - MeetingDetailsCubit(meetingsRepository, meetingPresencesRepository, authRepository, carnivalBlocksRepository, meetingId)
Screen widget class name `MeetingDetailsScreen` and constructor `const MeetingDetailsScreen({super.key})` preserved
NO emojis as icons - Material Symbols Rounded only
Delete icon in AppAppBar actions only shown when canDeleteMeeting; wrapped in AppDialog.confirm(isDestructive: true)
Presences list renders MemberCard + PresenceChip per row; PresenceChip uses .present/.absent/.pending factories
FAB for 'Marcar presença' disabled while MarkingPresenceStatus is loading
